notes: Dex lists from PokeAPI (species level, one entry per species, numbered from 1 with no gaps); counts and order match Serebii exactly (400, 200, 243). The in-game Pokédex has one entry per species in each dex, not one per form; a species in two dexes (e.g. Wooper) is one Pokémon shared by both (inferred). violetOnly/scarletOnly: species or forms that can't be caught in that version; 'dex' says which dexes list the species. A Violet player gets Scarlet-only ones by trade, Pokémon HOME, the Union Circle or another player's Tera Raid. Form-only exclusives (Paldean Tauros breeds, Alolan Vulpix/Ninetales, Alolan Sandshrew/Sandslash) are left out of each dex's violetOnlyHere/scarletOnlyHere because another form of the species is in both versions (whether the other form fills the entry: inferred, unsure). Species in the game: 664 in the three dexes + 28 not in any dex + 41 transfer-only = 733; Serebii says 292 are unavailable (733 + 292 = 1025). shinyLocked: kind 'species' = no in-game way to a shiny in Violet (events aside); 'this gift only' = the gift is locked but the species can be shiny another way.
